ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible fluke surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white mottled patch in the upper-distal region of the right lobe; smaller scattered white clusters at the distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an angle of approximately 45 degrees, vertex partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the right lobe trailing edge; the visible part of the left lobe shows more irregular, jagged topography.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white circular pixel clusters localized at the terminal tips of both the right and left lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dark vertical linear marks visible against the high-intensity white mottle on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at the lobe tips and irregular indentations along the trailing edge.
